title: Two different and robustly modeled DNA binding modes of Competence Protein ComP - systematic modeling with AlphaFold 3, RoseTTAFold2NA, Chai-1 and re-docking in HADDOCK
authors: Stian Aleksander Helsem; Kristian Alfsnes; Stephan A. Frye; Alexander Hesselberg Løvestad; Ole Herman Ambur
one_liner_zh: 该文利用AlphaFold 3、RoseTTAFold2NA、Chai-1及HADDOCK再对接系统建模细菌ComP蛋白与DNA摄取序列的多种结合模式，聚焦蛋白-DNA互作机制，方法先进且高度契合TF-DNA结合建模课题。
abstract: The competence protein ComP is a Type IV minor pilin and the extracellular DNA binding protein involved in natural transformation in the human pathogens Neisseria gonorrhoeae , Neisseria meningitidis, Eikenella corrodens and related Neisseriaceae bacteria. Details of the DNA binding mode of ComP is enigmatic, and the 3D structure of the DNA :: protein complex remains unresolved. Here we characterize the ComP orthologs in a set of Neisseriaceae family members, model their common structural domains and their interaction with different preferred 12 base pair long DNA binding motifs, DNA Uptake Sequences (DUS) and scrambled versions of these. Through systematic in silico modeling using AlphaFold 3, RoseTTAFold2NA, and Chai-1 and model comparisons, we bring a new understanding of the interactions between DNA and ComP. We report six distinct binding modes of which two, here named Epsilon and Gamma, were robustly modeled across platforms and different ComPs. The characteristics and robustness of the predicted models and DNA binding modes from each tool are assessed and discussed. This work expands the knowledge on the ComP :: DUS interaction and guides further wet- and dry-lab systematic and experimental characterization of these complexes through which molecular and clinical interventions may be developed.
abstract_zh: 能力蛋白ComP是一种IV型次要菌毛蛋白，也是参与人类病原体淋病奈瑟菌（Neisseria gonorrhoeae）、脑膜炎奈瑟菌（Neisseria meningitidis）、侵蚀艾肯菌（Eikenella corrodens）及相关奈瑟菌科细菌自然转化过程中的胞外DNA结合蛋白。ComP的DNA结合模式细节尚不明确，且DNA::蛋白复合物的三维结构仍未解析。在此，我们表征了奈瑟菌科家族成员中的一组ComP同源物，模拟了它们的共同结构域及其与不同偏好的12碱基对长DNA结合基序、DNA摄取序列（DUS）及其打乱版本之间的相互作用。通过使用AlphaFold 3、RoseTTAFold2NA和Chai-1进行系统性计算机模拟建模及模型比较，我们对DNA与ComP之间的相互作用有了新的理解。我们报告了六种不同的结合模式，其中两种（此处命名为Epsilon和Gamma）在不同平台和不同ComP中均被稳健建模。我们评估并讨论了每种工具预测模型和DNA结合模式的特征及稳健性。这项工作扩展了关于ComP::DUS相互作用的知识，并为这些复合物的进一步湿实验和干实验系统性及实验性表征提供了指导，从而可能推动分子和临床干预措施的发展。
